# Whitestone

> Ephemeral pro se legal app by Aziel Eliab for Criminal, Civil, and Divorce. Session-only memory. No third-party LLM APIs. Optional zip download. May cite allowlisted public court and legal-aid pages.

Whitestone is educational procedural software for all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia. Open the live app on a phone or desktop. End & erase wipes the session. Uploads stay in the browser. The Worker does not store case files. A software zip is optional.

Author: Aziel Eliab
Author @id: https://www.azieleliab.com/#aziel
